column3: BSB follows the critical text without “for us”; “in His body” renders “in the flesh.”
Close to the Greek; BSB follows the critical text without “us” and “of life.”
BSB renders “overflow of debauchery” as “flood of reckless indiscretion.”
BSB renders “having fervent love among yourselves” as “love one another deeply.”
BSB renders “fire for a trial” as “fiery trial.”
BSB follows the critical text without “on their part He is blasphemed, but on your part He is glorified,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB renders “in this name” as “that you bear that name.”
BSB renders “the house of God” as “the family of God.”
